::: {#sol-any-curve}

Yes, with enough units.
Mark points on the graph of $f$ at closely spaced values of $z$,
and join neighbouring points with straight lines.
Because $f$ is continuous on a closed interval,
it changes little between nearby points,
so the joined-up graph stays as close to $f$ as you like once the points are close enough together.
The joined-up graph is a chain of straight pieces with one bend at each inner point,
and by @sol-relu-bends a network with one unit per bend can draw such a chain:
each unit $v_i \maxf{0, z - t_i}$ adds a change of slope $v_i$ at its bend $t_i$.

:::
